# {{ site.title }} — Full Text

> {{ site.description }}

Source: {{ '/' | absolute_url }}
This file contains the complete text of every essay, pattern, and glossary entry
published on the site, for retrieval and long-context use by AI systems. Each
entry is delimited and includes its canonical source URL for attribution.
Diagram markup is removed; each diagram's caption is retained in place of it.
Question-and-answer sections are included in full.

Ordering note: the most-referenced essays come first, not the newest ones, so a
client that reads only part of this file still gets the material most often
asked about. The remaining essays follow in reverse-chronological order, then
patterns, then the glossary.
{% comment %}
  PASS 1 — priority. site.posts is reverse-chronological, which had put the
  most-cited essays (all older) at the bottom of a ~400 KB file, where any
  retrieval client that caps its read would never see them. site.llms_priority
  is maintained from the Bing AI Performance page report.

  The entry block is repeated in each pass rather than factored into an include,
  deliberately: Jekyll's `{% raw %}{% include f.txt k=v %}{% endraw %}` syntax cannot be parsed by
  standard Liquid, and this file is verified by rendering it through a Liquid
  engine before release. Verifiability beats DRY here — this file has shipped a
  silent bug before.
{% endcomment %}
{%- for url in site.llms_priority -%}
{%- assign post = site.posts | where: "url", url | first -%}
{%- if post %}
================================================================================
# {{ post.title }}
Source: {{ post.url | absolute_url }}
Published: {{ post.date | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}{% if post.last_modified_at %}
Updated: {{ post.last_modified_at | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}{% endif %}
Topic: {{ post.topic }}
Summary: {{ post.description }}
================================================================================

{% capture body %}{% assign chunks = post.content | split: '<svg' %}{% for chunk in chunks %}{% if forloop.first %}{{ chunk }}{% else %}{{ chunk | split: '</svg>' | last }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endcapture %}{{ body | strip_html | strip }}
{% if post.faq %}
## Questions and answers
{% for qa in post.faq %}
Q: {{ qa.q }}
A: {{ qa.a }}
{% endfor %}{% endif %}
{%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}
{%- comment -%} PASS 2 — everything else, newest first, skipping pass 1. {%- endcomment -%}
